title: Isandro and the Escarpment
author: Mirabel Ishikawa
blurb: Elodie Yarrow, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
